tools.name: publish_demand
tools.description: Submit B2B demand for review. MARS remains intermediary only.

tools.name: find_counterparty
tools.description: Search reviewed public demand or offers.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Create a quarantined RFQ without automatic contact.

tools.name: submit_commission_mandate
tools.description: Verify and record a principal-signed ECDSA P-256 commission mandate.

tools.name: record_attribution
tools.description: Record a Buyer-Supplier introduction under an active verified mandate.

tools.name: record_commission_event
tools.description: Verify principal-signed contract/payment evidence and update the commission evidence ledger without moving money.

tools.name: discover_commercial_counterparties
tools.description: Discover commercial public A2A/MCP services and B2B SaaS commission programs. Never contacts them automatically.

tools.name: submit_partner_application
tools.description: Submit a supplier/referral partnership application for identity and terms review.

tools.name: prepare_onboarding_proposal
tools.description: Prepare but do not send a partner onboarding proposal.

tools.name: mars_free_commercial_intelligence_preview
tools.description: FREE: return one evidence-bearing public supplier/procurement discovery result. The response includes the exact continuation to the 0.05 USDC Base Mainnet x402 service. No payment is required for this tool.

tools.name: mars_x402_commercial_intelligence_offer
tools.description: Inspect the exact paid-service offer without paying. Returns the HTTP x402 endpoint, 0.05 USDC price, Base Mainnet network, asset and receiver. To buy, call the returned HTTP endpoint and satisfy its standard x402 Payment-Required challenge.

tools.name: mars_deal_route_precheck
tools.description: FREE first-stop routing precheck. Send a deal to MARS first; MARS evaluates preliminary fit, economics evidence, and whether it should handle/orchestrate the deal or route it to an external agent/provider. This tool does not accept jobs, contact counterparties, execute providers, broadcast transacti

tools.name: mars_micro_commercial_intelligence_offer
tools.description: Inspect the 0.01 USDC Base Mainnet x402 proof offer. It returns 3 evidence-ranked results plus a compact decision summary before you commit to the 0.05 USDC full product.

tools.name: mars_purchase_feedback
tools.description: FREE optional reason-coded feedback. No free text, IP, User-Agent, referrer, or raw journey id is stored.

tools.name: mars_commerce_quote
tools.description: FREE task-to-price resolver. Describe the commercial task; MARS returns the selected value contract, exact price, alternatives, and the one paid execution URL. No payment is performed by this tool.

tools.name: mars_commerce_reputation
tools.description: FREE evidence-only reliability view. Separates external settlement evidence from controlled or unattributed settlement evidence and exposes non-test usage counts without synthetic scores.

tools.name: mars_commerce_recover
tools.description: FREE recovery after TOO_EXPENSIVE, PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_TRUST or another structured feedback reason. Uses buyer budget when provided and never performs payment.

tools.name: mars_commerce_handshake
tools.description: FREE read-only capability and commercial compatibility handshake. Returns canonical Commerce V3, x402 rail, tiers and policy invariants. This tool never performs payment or contact.
